# Plate Panel Elastoplastic Capacity + Permanent Set under Patch (Ice-Floe) Load

## Anchor: GAP-PP-3-ICE-STRUCT-PLASTIC-SET

## 1. Case Introduction

板格在低温冰载荷（大斑patch load）下的弹塑性承载能力与永久挠度分析。这是冰区航行结构设计的核心问题——冰板撞击船体板格时，板格进入塑性后能吸收多少能量、卸载后留下多少永久变形。

### Geometry & Material

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Plate | Simply supported, a = b = 1.000 m, t = 20 mm (t/a = 0.020) |
| Patch load | 500 × 500 mm centred = 0.25 of the area |
| Material | DH36, σ_y(20°C) = 355 MPa, σ_y(-40°C) = 383.8 MPa |
| E, ν | 210 GPa, 0.3 |
| Plate stiffness D | 153.85 kN·m |
| FE model | Layered Shell4 (Q4, 2×2 Gauss, J2 plane stress, isotropic hardening H = 20 GPa), 6×6 mesh, 3 layers |

### Low-Temperature Flow Stress

DH36钢在-40°C下的流动应力通过线性拟合获得：σ_y(T) = σ_y(20°C) + slope × (20°C - T)，slope = 0.48 MPa/K。

| Temperature (°C) | σ_y (MPa) | Amplification |
|---|---|---|
| 20 | 355.0 | 1.000 |
| 0 | 364.6 | 1.027 |
| -20 | 374.2 | 1.054 |
| **-40** | **383.8** | **1.081** |
| -60 | 393.4 | 1.108 |

## 2. Method

1. **Closed-form references** — Navier双级数求解简支矩形板在矩形中心斑载荷下的弹性解；Mises表面应力σ = 6M/t²得到首屈服压力；刚性塑性屈服线上界定理（m_p = σ_y t²/4）；静力许可双向条带下界。
2. **Elastoplastic FE path** — Layered Shell4 J2板单元，载荷控制+Newton失败时自适应二分法；可选弹性卸载腿。首屈服通过最外层两层线性外推到z = ±t/2检测。
3. **Permanent deflection** — 从峰值载荷卸载到零，读取残余中心挠度。

## 3. Results

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Analytic first-yield pressure | 0.8692 MPa |
| FE first yield (surface) | 0.7871 MPa |
| Relative error vs analytic (raw) | **-9.45%** |
| Same-mesh elastic first yield | 0.7871 MPa |
| Relative error vs same-mesh elastic | **+0.00%** |
| Yield-line upper bound | 1.8422 MPa |
| Strip lower bound | 0.8188 MPa |
| FE collapse (near-ideal plasticity) | 2.6077 MPa |
| Collapse / layering correction (1-1/n) | 1.7385 MPa = **-5.63%** vs upper bound |
| Peak overload | 1.5646 MPa (1.80× first yield) |
| Peak centre deflection | 40.569 mm |
| **Permanent deflection after unload** | **13.856 mm** (34.2% of peak) |
| Same-mesh elastic surface stress bias | +10.43% |

### Load-Deflection Path

| p (MPa) | w (mm) | α_max | σ_Mises (MPa) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.261 | 4.45 | 0.000 | 127.2 |
| 0.522 | 8.90 | 0.000 | 254.3 |
| 0.782 | 13.36 | 0.000 | 381.5 |
| 1.043 | 17.81 | 0.001 | 508.6 |
| 1.304 | 23.76 | 0.001 | 592.5 |
| 1.565 | 40.57 | 0.003 | 665.6 |

### Unloading Path

| p (MPa) | w (mm) |
|---|---|
| 1.043 | 31.66 |
| 0.522 | 22.76 |
| 0.000 | **13.86** |

## 4. Error Judgement

| Criterion | Value | Threshold | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Elastic → plastic transition vs analytic yield load | -9.45% | < 5% | **FAIL (raw)** — attributed to element elastic bias |
| Transition vs same-mesh elastic field | +0.00% | < 5% | **PASS** |
| Collapse vs yield-line upper bound (layering-corrected) | -5.63% | < 10% | **PASS** |
| Collapse vs upper bound (raw, no correction) | +41.55% | < 10% | FAIL — layering over-strengths by 1.50× |

## 5. Notes & Limitations

- **Layered Shell4 elastic bias**: 单元在给定压力下仅复现约100%的闭式峰值表面弯矩；本案例偏差+10.43%（表面应力），均匀载荷挠度偏软13%。这是网格和厚度无关的离散化偏移，无法通过加密消除。
- **Through-thickness layering**: n=3层时外层应力采样点在|z|=t/2(1-1/n)，塑性流动延迟1.50×。崩溃载荷同时报告原始值和校正值。
- **Small-rotation shell**: 未捕捉膜stiffening，w~t以上的挠度超出模型有效性。
- **Flow stress model**: 线性拟合，非材料证书；低于DBTT时塑性分支被有意保留。
